title: Conservation Extremists
html:
Quest Giver: Soldier Kwale in Algors Terror Dome Base Camp.

Quest Type: Hunt

Quest Description: Kill 35 Ice Orok Agitators in the branches Upper Algor's Terror-Dome.

Quest Reward: 3250 Gold

Return to: Soldier Kwale in Algors Terror Dome Base Camp

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Conservation Extremists (2)

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Head into the Branches off of Upper Algor's Terror-Dome and Slay 35 Ice Orok Agitators then Report to Soldier Kwale in Algor's Terror-Dome Base Camp.

Offer:

Algor has made his first major move; sending his most dedicated Ice Oroks, the Agitators, into the branches off of Upper Algor's Terror-Dome. This overtly passive assertive aggression will not stand! So, I am choosing to send you, once more, into the gap!

If that didn't get your health potions bubbling I don't know what will!

The Agitators absolutely cannot be allowed to operate in this dungeon. You have no idea how dangerous their ability to spread the message throughout the Kingdom really is. No one can stand against their powers of persuasion: The Sirenly Sing-a-Long, The Dreaded Drum Circle, and The Hallowed Hacky Sack. Not to mention just how effective something that refuses to bathe really can be at persuasion!

Get into the branches of the dungeon located off of Upper Algor's Terror-Dome and slay those Agitators! Don't worry about the Ice Orok Leaders yet, we just want to start out by denting their lower ranks. Only target the Ice Orok Runts, Scouts, and Shamans.

This dungeon is important to our fiscal outlook for the upcoming year and I won't have it grinded to a halt by these hippies! Get out there and put the FUN in Extreme Conservation FUN-damentalists! Return to me, Soldier Kwale, in Algor's Terror-Dome Base Camp when you are finished.

Turn-in:

Glad to see you, Dungeon Runner. These Ice Orok Agitators are really starting to stir things up, aren't they.

Objectives:

  • Slain Ice Orok Agitators

Level range: 13–25
